title: Phase7b arm R target 1 (D2): experience store available, reuse what fits (self-modifying harness)
text:
Target 1/9: D2 (Ki). Build the most reliable binding-activity predictor and rank the 100k library.

labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/d(2)_dopamine_recept/ki/dataset_p7b.csv

split: pass /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/d(2)_dopamine_recept/ki/splits/frozen_d(2)_dopamine_recept.json as --split-manifest to ml.train. Do not call data.split.
store: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/experience/experience_r.json (the `store` argument of experience.retrieve)
finish with: evaluation.locked --target D2 --endpoint Ki --desc-set <the set you trained on> --receipt evaluation/d2_locked.json

Report: choices and why; validation AUROC/AUPRC/EF@1%; the locked AUROC quoted from the receipt; top-100 path; wall clock and job count; experience ids reused.
